subject: Add support for NEON intrinsics
perf_evidence: Message: adds support for dividing NEON vector types by a fixed constant; introduces SIMD code paths and benchmarks.
change_summary: Introduces NEON vector division APIs for signed and unsigned 32/64-bit lanes.
notes: New entry points cannot be compared to the absent old API. The lanewise experiment is inconclusive and is not promoted to equivalence or non-equivalence.

units.name: new NEON vector division API / attempted lanewise comparison
units.evidence: The parent has no corresponding NEON vector API; Alive2 attempts on a lanewise model failed to prove either direction.
